import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
cmd=[str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'jobpipe.py','apply-csv','--priorities','Medium','--statuses','Needs user','--limit','1','--preview']
r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
print('PREVIEW_EXIT',r.returncode)
if r.returncode==0:
 import json
 data=json.loads(r.stdout)
 print('SELECTION_COUNT',len(data.get('jobs',[])))
 print('SELECTED_COMPANIES',[j.get('company') for j in data.get('jobs',[])])
else:
 print('PREVIEW_ERROR_CLASS',r.stderr[-400:])
